payload.value: {"checks": [{"command": ["gh", "run", "list", "--workflow", "e2e-install.yml", "--branch", "term-3osnol", "--limit", "1", "--json", "conclusion,databaseId,createdAt,updatedAt"], "criterion": "When install.sh --unattended --agents all runs in a fresh ubuntu:24.04 container, setup shall end with Setup complete. and uv, python3 3.14, node v26, claude, copilot and codex shall each print a version.", "expected": "conclusion success; both linux-container jobs passed the Install as a consumer and Check the version lines steps"}, {"command": ["gh", "run", "list", "--workflow", "e2e-install.yml", "--branch", "term-3osnol", "--limit", "1", "--json", "conclusion,databaseId,createdAt,updatedAt"], "criterion": "When install.sh --unattended --agents all runs a second time in the same container, setup shall report uv, Python and Node as present or up to date instead of installing them.", "expected": "conclusion success; both linux-container jobs passed the Run setup again and expect present tools step"}, {"command": ["rg", "-n", "linux-container:|schedule:|workflow_dispatch:|tags:", ".github/workflows/e2e-install.yml", ".github/workflows/quality-gates.yml"], "criterion": "The container jobs shall run in the e2e-install workflow on tags, on a weekly schedule and on workflow_dispatch, and not in quality-gates.", "expected": "e2e-install.yml lists tags, schedule, workflow_dispatch and linux-container; quality-gates.yml has no linux-container"}], "contract": "dor.v3", "revision": "8f9a49e35d5bc1afb362a0ee940366230cef7606e9dc90911bbbaa0bdb48fd57", "writer": "agent:claude-code_2-1-328_agent"}
